data.one_liner: A dependency‑free toast list widget for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Wrap your app with ToastListOverlay and call context.showToast to display custom toasts that stack, animate and auto‑hide. The toasts stay above every screen and can be any widget you build.
use_when: Want full control over toast appearance and animation
Need to show multiple toast types or persistent toasts
Require toasts that survive navigation changes
avoid_when: You need built‑in styling or theme integration
You already use a comprehensive toast package like toastification or bot_toast
strengths: Handles navigation and nested navigators gracefully
weaknesses: No built‑in styles – you must design the toast yourself
Limited to simple toast logic – no advanced features like queues or priority
data.setup_notes: Add ToastListOverlay around your MaterialApp and call context.showToast from any descendant widget.

alternatives.name: toastification
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides ready‑made toast styles, themes, and advanced features like queueing and auto‑dismiss options.

alternatives.name: fluttertoast
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simple API for quick toasts but less flexible for custom widgets.

alternatives.name: bot_toast
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers rich customization and built‑in animations but adds a dependency.
